brief.paper_summary:
由于现实世界中的大多数数据都可以用图表示，因此近年来针对图表示学
习的研究越来越受到关注。通过将高维图数据转化成低维的表征向量，图表示
学习可以有效地对图的信息进行存储并快捷地访问图中实体的关键知识。利用
学习到的图表征数据可以为社交网络行为分析、节点分类、链路预测和聚类等
下游任务提供帮助。随着深度学习的快速发展，研究人员提出了基于图神经网
络的图表示学习方法，其使图中的节点能够同时学习图的结构信息以及邻域节
点的特征信息，从而得到高质量的低维表征。针对图神经网络上的图表示学
习，本文主要关注两个问题：大规模时序图场景下的图表示学习方法和分布式
场景下的大规模图的图神经网络优化训练方法。
真实世界中的图数据规模往往十分庞大且处于动态变化的状态，而现有的
图神经网络要么无法处理动态时序图上的图表征学习，要么面对大规模图数据
集时训练效率低下。为了解决大规模动态图上的图表征学习问题，本文提出了
一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法——GSAERU 模型。GSAERU 模
型由“图表征学习模块”和“时序学习模块”两部分构成。首先将动态时序图
建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列，接着在单时间步上将图快照输入图表征学习
模块。该模块通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩，并将压缩后的新图输入图自编
码器，利用和原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征。在获得单时间步上的图表
征后将其输入时序学习模块，并通过一个循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上
的特征信息与依赖关系，从而得到大规模时序图的高质量表征。基于在四个真
实世界的大规模图数据集上的大量实验表明，GSAERU 模型能够高效生成时序
图的表征。与传统的图神经网络算法相比，其平均内存消耗和平均训练时长只
有其9.86% 与13.27%，且与性能最好的算法在大部分指标下的差距都不超过
3.5%。

ii
使用分布式技术加速神经网络训练也是如今热门的研究课题，因为在处理
大规模数据时，单个设备（如CPU，GPU）有限的内存和计算资源往往会成为
训练瓶颈。而分布式技术可以提供更多的计算资源来提高训练效率。然而由于
图数据的不规则性，传统分布式机器学习方法中的子任务划分和模型训练方法
难以直接应用于图神经网络。针对大规模图流数据场景下的分布式图神经网络
训练优化问题，本文提出了基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法——
DSGNN 模型。DSGNN 模型采用“领导——工作者”工作模式，首先由领导节
点利用一个基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分并将划分子图分配给各
个工作节点。工作节点随后执行一个基于图摘要技术的小批量训练并将训练结
果通过一个注意力层返回给领导节点，最后由领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，
并根据梯度同步更新所有计算节点上的模型。基于四个真实世界的大规模图数
据集上的大量实验，结果表明DSGNN 模型可以大大加速GNN 模型的训练，
并且在链路预测任务上的F1 分数显著高于其它分布式图神经网络模型。
brief.research_problem: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要技术的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要压缩原图并输入图自编码器学习节点表征，再利用循环神经网络建模时间维度依赖，显著降低内存消耗和训练时间。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which compresses the original graph via graph summarization, inputs the compressed graph into a graph autoencoder to learn node representations, and then uses a recurrent neural network to model temporal dependencies, significantly reducing memory consumption and training time.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列
利用图摘要技术对单时间步图快照进行压缩
将压缩后的图输入图自编码器，使用与原图的重构误差训练节点表征
使用循环神经网络学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model the dynamic sequential graph as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each moment
Compress the single-time-step graph snapshot using graph summarization technology
Input the compressed graph into a graph autoencoder and train node representations using reconstruction error with the original graph
Use a recurrent neural network to learn feature information and dependencies in the time dimension

novelty_points.claim: 提出基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用领导-工作者模式，通过基于边分割的图流划分算法分配子图，工作节点基于图摘要进行小批量训练，并通过注意力层将结果返回给领导节点，领导节点汇总后计算梯度并同步更新模型，加速训练并提升链路预测性能。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, which adopts the leader-worker mode, distributes subgraphs via a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization and return results to the leader through an attention layer, the leader aggregates results to compute gradients and synchronously updates all models, accelerating training and improving link prediction performance.
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者工作模式，由领导节点划分原图并分配给工作节点
领导节点使用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Adopt the leader-worker mode, the leader partitions the original graph and assigns subgraphs to workers
The leader uses a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation to partition the original graph
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
The leader summarizes results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法，用于分布式图神经网络训练中的子图划分，由领导节点执行，能够针对大规模图流数据进行高效划分。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation, which is used for subgraph partitioning in distributed graph neural network training, executed by the leader node, capable of efficiently partitioning large-scale graph streaming data.
technical_features: 领导节点使用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
将划分后的子图分配给各个工作节点
该算法针对大规模图流数据设计
technical_features_en: The leader node partitions the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation
Assign the partitioned subgraphs to each worker node
The algorithm is designed for large-scale graph streaming data

research_tasks.description: For novelty point NP-3, no valid evidence card has been obtained in the previous round. This round performs an English literature search specifically for algorithms of edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning used in distributed graph neural network training, aiming to find at least one relevant piece of evidence that can be validated for this claim.

evidence_cards.document_title: DGC: Training Dynamic Graphs with Spatio-Temporal Non-Uniformity using Graph Partitioning by Chunks
evidence_cards.main_contribution: DGC proposes a distributed DGNN training system that partitions dynamic graphs into chunks using graph coarsening, modeling dynamic graphs as snapshots with structure encoders (GCN) and time encoders (RNN/GRU), achieving significant training speedup.
overlaps: Models dynamic graphs as a sequence of snapshots at each timestep (feature 1)
Uses graph coarsening, a form of graph summarization, to compress/partition dynamic graph snapshots (feature 2)
Uses RNN/GRU as time encoders to model temporal dependencies across snapshots (feature 4)
differences: DGC does not use a graph autoencoder for representation learning; it uses GCN structure encoders and RNN time encoders for DGNN training
DGC focuses on distributed training acceleration via graph partitioning, not on learning node representations via reconstruction error with the original graph
DGC's graph coarsening is used for partitioning to minimize cross-GPU communication, not for compressing the graph to reduce memory consumption in representation learning

sources.title: DGC: Training Dynamic Graphs with Spatio-Temporal Non-Uniformity using Graph Partitioning by Chunks
sources.quote: a dynamic graph is divided into a number of snapshots, each of which represents the graph at a specific time. These snapshots are fed to structure encoders (e.g., GCN), respectively, followed by time encoders (e.g., RNN) to exploit temporal relationship across snapshots.

sources.title: DGC: Training Dynamic Graphs with Spatio-Temporal Non-Uniformity using Graph Partitioning by Chunks
sources.quote: This partitioning algorithm is based on graph coarsening, which can run very fast on large graphs.

sources.title: DGC: Training Dynamic Graphs with Spatio-Temporal Non-Uniformity using Graph Partitioning by Chunks
sources.quote: T-GCN (Zhao et al., 2019) uses three 2-layer GCN (Kipf and Welling, 2016) as the structure encoder, and a 1-layer GRU (Cho et al., 2014) model as the time encoder.

evidence_cards.document_title: AGL: a Scalable System for Industrial-purpose Graph Machine Learning
evidence_cards.main_contribution: AGL is a scalable, fault-tolerant, and integrated system for distributed GNN training and inference, using parameter servers and k-hop neighborhood subgraphs to achieve data independence for training.
overlaps: Training on parameter servers for distributed model updates
differences: Uses parameter server architecture rather than leader-worker mode with edge-based graph flow partition
Uses k-hop neighborhood subgraphs rather than graph summarization for mini-batch training
Does not use an attention layer for aggregating worker results
Does not specifically target link prediction performance

sources.title: AGL: a Scalable System for Industrial-purpose Graph Machine Learning
sources.quote: we design AGL, a scalable, fault-tolerance and integrated system, with fully-functional training and inference for GNNs

sources.title: AGL: a Scalable System for Industrial-purpose Graph Machine Learning
sources.quote: we simply do the training on parameter servers due to data independency

evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposes WStream, a window-based streaming graph partitioning algorithm that uses edge-cut partitioning to partition large graph data efficiently while balancing load across partitions and minimizing communication.
overlaps: Both address graph stream partitioning algorithms for large-scale graph data
Both involve a central/leader node distributing partitioned data to worker nodes
differences: WStream targets general distributed graph applications, not specifically distributed GNN training
WStream uses vertex-based edge-cut partitioning (distributes vertices), whereas the novelty point claims edge-segmentation-based partitioning
WStream uses a central graph loader rather than a leader node explicitly executing the partition algorithm

sources.title: Window-based Streaming Graph Partitioning Algorithm
sources.quote: This paper proposes an efficient window-based streaming graph partitioning algorithm called WStream. The WStream algorithm is an edge-cut partitioning algorithm, which distributes a vertex among the partitions.

sources.title: Window-based Streaming Graph Partitioning Algorithm
sources.quote: Our results suggest that the WStream algorithm is able to partition large graph data efficiently while keeping the load balanced across different partitions, and communication to a minimum.
